agents: Morning Compass
Prioritize a list of fictional appointments and tasks.
I have [TASKS] and [APPOINTMENTS]. Create a conflict-free plan with buffers and top-three priorities. Ask when important information is missing. Never change my calendar without approval.
No overlapping appointments or invented commitments.
Inbox Tamer
Sort sample subjects and draft replies.
Categorize [SAMPLE EMAILS] into urgent, action, waiting and archive. Draft replies but never send, delete or archive anything without my approval.
Every category is explained; nothing is sent.
Money Mirror
Group invented transactions and compute totals.
Analyze [SYNTHETIC TRANSACTIONS]. Verify arithmetic, show category totals and distinguish fact from recommendation. Do not trade or transfer money.
Food ₹850 + ₹300 = ₹1150; totals match inputs.
Research Ranger
Verify a claim using original sources.
Research [QUESTION]. Cite primary sources and dates; distinguish verified facts, contested claims and estimates. Say when a source cannot be confirmed.
Every cited link actually supports its associated statement.
Meeting Magician
Turn fictional notes into action items.
Summarize [MEETING NOTES]. List decisions and actions. Only assign owners or deadlines explicitly mentioned; flag missing details.
No invented owners, promises or due dates.
Creator Studio
Generate slide, image and video plan.
Turn [IDEA] into 5 original slides, 3 visual prompts and a 45-second voiceover. Avoid claims without evidence and avoid copying protected artwork.
Script timing and slide content are consistent.
Smart Buyer
Compare options by evidence.
Compare [ITEMS] for [BUDGET] and [REQUIREMENTS]. Show total costs and trustworthy supporting sources. Mark missing prices unknown; never place an order.
No invented live prices or warranties.
Quiz Quest
Teach progressively and adapt questions.
Teach me [TOPIC] with one analogy and one question at a time. Give a hint before revealing answers; increase difficulty with mastery.
Feedback correct; questions grow gradually harder.
Care & Maintenance
Build equipment checklist from official intervals.
Given [EQUIPMENT] and [OFFICIAL SERVICE INTERVALS], draft a checklist. Treat all missing specifications as unknown. Do not invent torque or critical safety values.
No unverified maintenance intervals or settings.

terms.AI: Software that performs tasks associated with human intelligence.
terms.LLM: Large language model; generates token sequences based on learned patterns.
terms.GPU: Parallel computing processor used in model training and inference.
terms.Model: A learned mathematical system that maps inputs to predictions.
terms.Parameter: Learned numeric value inside a model.
terms.Weight: A parameter representing the influence of a signal.
terms.Token: A text chunk, sometimes a whole word or part of one.
terms.Context window: The limited amount of tokenized content a model considers at once.
terms.Training: Adjusting parameters by learning patterns from data.
terms.Inference: Using a trained model to produce an output.
terms.Hallucination: A plausible-sounding but unsupported or false answer.
terms.Agent: A workflow/system that observes, chooses actions and uses tools toward a goal.
terms.API: Interface for one program to communicate with another.
terms.RAG: Retrieval-augmented generation: fetch evidence before answering.
terms.Vibe coding: Using natural-language instructions to help build and iterate on software.
terms.GitHub Pages: Hosting for static sites based on a GitHub repository.
